prior_summary: Contact-event memory rather than an episode clock. A two-observation GRU feeds a learned eight-phase, duration-augmented ordered filter. Its soft posterior and censored dwell statistic gate phase-specific conditioning adapters of a shared learned action diffusion denoiser. Soft contact-motion phase supervision, ordered future-phase prediction, anti-chatter and transition-consistency losses train the latent representation over the entire expanded slice.
applicable_conditions: State-based drawer exchange with demonstrated handle/block geometry and compliance. Inputs are two causal 20 Hz observations: qpos/qvel, world TCP/red/blue poses, drawer displacement and velocity, and goal coordinates. Supports initial open-finger rest and mid-overlap takeover from pulling through red initial lift; initialize from observations, not an episode clock. Two frames and no commands are the actual interface limits; contact is inferred, not measured.
termination_guidance: Opening beyond 0.26 m is an intermediate geometric achievement, not an instruction to stop. Continue through handle release with fingers opening toward 0.04 m each, upward retreat, red approach, closure near 0.0182 m per finger and correlated initial red/TCP lift. A useful late transfer has drawer displacement about 0.300 m and red/TCP heights about 0.143 m with the last demonstrated command closed. Transfer earlier within the supported overlap when the successor can continue that phase. Do not reset the gripper at a switch. These are skill guidance, not new task-success conditions.
limitations: The requested 0.5-1 s recurrent command history is unavailable: this is a stateless two-frame approximation with learned, uncalibrated censored duration beliefs, not persistent event memory. Pose/co-motion phase labels are proxies, not force or attachment truth. No previous command input, IK, kinematic guarantees, image encoder, equivariance, collision constraint or recovery validation is implemented. Ordered phases can impede retries. Successful-only demonstrations cannot calibrate contact certainty or failure recovery. Fixed execution is eight actions per replan, not event-adaptive.

config.architecture: Shared Conditional U-Net epsilon predictor with causal GRU and ordered phase-duration conditioning adapters
config.normalization: Unmodified shared complete-original-demonstration limits normalizer; no slice refit
config.duration_last_bin: 0.75 seconds or longer; latent and uncalibrated
config.transition_topology: Stay and increment censored age, or advance one phase and reset age; final phase absorbs. All phases are possible at the oldest input observation.
config.future_observations: Masked training labels only, never denoiser inputs
config.segmentation: Retain every assigned action, including all shared transition actions; no reselection or stage cropping
